answer: Cosignatures are collected in thread, verified in pulse, and zephyr names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 31 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. That bill is paid per identity, so 254 aliases cost 72 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
